protocol.purpose: v6.2 review-response diagnostics for Q3 (anchor-direct-projection ablation; beer156 sensitivity)
protocol.noRetraining: both diagnostics are post-processing of frozen artifacts: no generator, projection model, marginal or QP hyper-parameter is refitted other than recomputing the frozen EXP-0109 fold standardisers and the deterministic EXP-0110 transfer QP solves

anchorDirectProjection.label: MAIN-DERIVED DIAGNOSTIC: the delivered Q3 transfer remains qp-quantile-anchor (V = 2.0798861351916886); this ablation is not a replacement

definition.ablation: keep the main scheme's quantile anchor z_anchor and project it DIRECTLY onto the declared feasible set with _project_box_halfspace(z_anchor, low, up, arow, b): no PCA quadratic term and no L1 term
definition.feasibleSet: low <= z <= up (declared training support, 33 LINEAR_CALIBRATED columns >= 0, four per-coordinate chemistry caps c_new <= c_source) and the single corrected stale_hops half-space a'z <= b with b = a'z_source + 1e-9; identical low/up/arow/b to qp-quantile-anchor
definition.energy: V = 2*mean d(G,R) - sum d(G,G)/m^2 - sum d(R,R)/n^2 against the fold's target-style training reference Z_target; pooled over cells weighting by m (the delivered pooling)
definition.protocol: 11 Pils/Lager source beers x 3 repeats x 3 outer folds = 99 projected points

residuals.note: box/half-space residuals are the projection's own feasibility residuals; the delivered constraint violations are the physical chemistry non-increase checks plus the proxy row

exportedAnchorValues.columnNaming: column = q3.csv storage name including the chem__ prefix
exportedAnchorValues.src_stored: the raw stored source cell from data/clean/q3.csv (blank when the source cell is NaN)
exportedAnchorValues.anchor_stored: centre + scale * z_anchor = the quantile_anchor_storage vector used by build_problem
exportedAnchorValues.anchor_physical: 10**anchor_stored for calibrated_log10, anchor_stored for calibrated_linear, NaN for uncalibrated columns (src/q3_v62_answer_tables.to_physical)
exportedAnchorValues.note: the raw quantile anchor is not projected; the QP / anchor-direct-projection start from it. This file lets the paper quote the actual anchor values instead of 'not persisted'.

representativeAnchor.selectionRule: repeat=0, outer fold=0, smallest Pils/Lager source_beer id
representativeAnchor.columnNaming: column = the q3.csv storage name including the chem__ prefix; anchor_stored = centre + scale * z_anchor = the quantile_anchor_storage vector actually passed to build_problem

staleHopsProxy.column: stale_hops (sensory ridge proxy, NOT one of the 231 chem__ features)

reconstruction.route: refit StyleMarginals(omega=0) on the fold's Pils/Lager training rows -> source empirical CDF -> target StyleMarginals(KAPPA).inverse -> storage vector; compared with centre + scale*z_anchor from build_problem

feasibility.note: reported honestly: the raw quantile anchor is NOT required to be feasible. The declared box caps the four source-capped chemistry columns at c_source and the stale proxy row is a'z<=b; the QP/projection enforces both. Box violations occur only on those capped chemistry coordinates.

rawAnchorFeasibility.label: honest feasibility of the RAW quantile anchor (before projection / QP)
rawAnchorFeasibility.note: reported honestly: the raw quantile anchor is not a feasible point of the declared set. All box violations sit on the four source-capped chemistry columns; the stale proxy row is violated part of the time. This is exactly why the delivered pipeline projects / optimises the anchor, and it is not a defect of the anchor export.

refinement.interpretation: the quantile anchor provides nearly all of the distance gain; the QP adds ~0.50% distance refinement on top of it, plus the explicit L1 control

l1Comparison.definition: l1_change_z = sum_i |z_i - z_source,i| in the fold-standardised space; mean_abs_change_z is the same divided by 231. Both are evaluated on the DELIVERED point (99 points each: 11 sources x 3 repeats x 3 folds).
l1Comparison.interpretation: the plain projection has the larger mean L1 move; the QP trades ~0.50% of distance refinement for ~0.63% smaller L1 displacement, which is its declared explicit control on how far a source beer may move

beer156Sensitivity.label: SENSITIVITY DIAGNOSTIC: the delivered primary metric keeps all 231 coordinates

coordinate.storageTier: LINEAR_CALIBRATED (stored as the concentration; non-negativity applies)
coordinate.note: this column has no declared defect threshold; the outlier is a real stored value, not a missing/floor code (0 missing, no repeated detection-limit atom)

foldEnergyKriek.denominatorRule: each cell value is V/D_train for that fold and style, D_train = mean pairwise distance of the Kriek TRAIN rows in that fold's standardised space

beforeAfter.method: distance evaluation only: drop the ONE coordinate chem__X2.methyltetrahydrofuran.3.one simultaneously from the generated block, the real block and the D_train denominator; the generated samples, the fold contexts and every delivered artifact are unchanged

numberDefinitions.allStyles_V_normalized_0.8727: n_gen-weighted mean over the 177 estimable (repeat,fold,style) design cells of V_cell/D_train_cell; denominator = 729 generated spectra; raw pooled V = 15.999946
numberDefinitions.Kriek_V_normalized_7.4079: n_gen-weighted mean over the 9 Kriek design cells (30 generated Kriek spectra) of V_cell/D_train_cell. It is a NORMALISED POOLED per-cell statistic, NOT a raw per-style V: raw pooled Kriek V = 140.402185
n_gen-weighted mean over the 27 estimable Tripel/Kriek/Lambic cells; denominator = 147 generated spectra; raw pooled V = 33.782887
numberDefinitions.per_fold_Kriek_values: the values 22.61-23.93 (beer156 held out) and 0.58-0.77 (other folds) are single-cell V/D_train values; their n_gen-weighted mean is the pooled 7.4079 value, so per-fold and pooled numbers have DIFFERENT denominators and must not be averaged together as if they were the same statistic
numberDefinitions.denominators: every pooled value uses n_gen as the cell weight (the delivered EXP-0109 pooling rule); V_normalized always divides by the fold/style D_train, never by a variance or by the number of samples

primaryMetricUntouched.statement: all 231 coordinates are kept in every delivered artifact; the coordinate-dropped numbers are a SENSITIVITY DIAGNOSTIC ONLY and never replace the primary metric

definition.referenceSet: the SAME outer fold's training rows (X_train): fold median imputation, then the EXP-0109 fold standardiser (mean/std of the imputed training rows)
definition.generatedSet: the delivered EXP-0109 copula-selected design spectra (3 repeats x 3 outer folds, 750 rows)
definition.exactRowMatch: a generated row matches a training row when all 231 chem__ cells differ by <= 1e-12; the rate is matches / 750
definition.nearestDistance: per generated row, the minimum standardised Euclidean distance to any training row of the same fold; the pooled value is the unweighted mean over all 750 generated rows
definition.relationToWithinBatch: the within-batch duplicate share (table q3-quality, 0.0000) measures repeats inside the generated batch; this diagnostic measures copying of TRAINING rows. The two are different statements and neither substitutes for the other

controls_match_EXP0110_artifact.note: max abs diff over V, U, V_normalized pooled and 9 per-fold cells x 5 strategies

anchorDirect_max_constraint_violation.note: max over the 99 points of max(box lower, box upper, stale half-space, chemistry non-increase)

anchorDirect_chemistry_nonincrease_resid.note: physical c_new - c_source; must be <= 0 (fp tolerance)

anchorDirect_delivered_constraint_violat.note: delivered_metrics: four chemistry non-increase checks + stale proxy row per point

anchorDirect_V_near_2.0903.note: the full-precision value is stored in this dict; the review quotes 2.0903

qp_has_smaller_mean_L1_than_direct_proje.expected: qp mean L1 < direct mean L1
qp_has_smaller_mean_L1_than_direct_proje.note: the QP's eta*sum|z-z_source| term is its explicit L1 control

representative_source_beer.note: fixed rule: repeat=0, outer fold=0, smallest Pils/Lager source beer id

representative_anchor_reconstruction_max.note: independent route: source empirical CDF -> target style marginal inverse -> storage vector; compared with centre + scale*z_anchor from build_problem; tolerance 1e-12

anchor_stored_equals_build_problem_ancho.note: centre + scale*z_anchor vs the quantile_anchor_storage vector actually passed to build_problem

all_anchor_box_violations_only_on_declar.note: honest feasibility: 99/99 raw quantile anchors lie outside the capped box; every violating coordinate is a declared source-capped chemistry column (c_new<=c_source), which the QP / projection enforces

representative_anchor_stale_halfspace_re.expected: reported honestly (anchor not required to satisfy the proxy row)
representative_anchor_stale_halfspace_re.note: the raw anchor is not forced onto the stale_hops proxy row a'z<=b; the QP enforces it. Residual reported for transparency

kriek_bad_folds_V_normalized_range.note: single-cell V/D_train; the three beer156 held-out folds

kriek_good_folds_V_normalized_range.note: single-cell V/D_train; the six other Kriek folds

coordinate_standardized_by_held_out_fold.note: (beer156 stored value - fold train centre) / fold train scale

crossset_rows.note: cross-set diagnostic covers all 750 delivered design spectra

crossset_exact_row_matches.note: no design spectrum duplicates a same-fold training row on all 231 chem__ cells (atol 1e-12)
